deviation: The draft auto-renews for successive 12-month terms, where the standard says no automatic renewal. This matches Arcadia's fallback, and the 120-day notice window is longer than the 90-day minimum, but it means Arcadia must decide earlier to avoid being locked in. The draft has no cap on renewal price increases, which the playbook requires whenever auto-renewal is accepted.
suggested_text: 3.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues until November 27, 2029 (the "Initial Term"). 3.2 Upon expiry of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall renew for successive periods of twelve (12) months (each a "Renewal Term", and together with the Initial Term, the "Term") unless either Party gives the other at least ninety (90) days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term. 3.3 Fees for any Renewal Term shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) over the fees applicable in the immediately preceding term.
